text.tspan: Augmented Human Development Index vs. GDP per capita 2020
The Augmented Human Development Index (AHDI) is a summary measure of achievement in four key
dimensions of human development: a long and healthy life, being knowledgeable, being free and having a
decent standard of living. GDP per capita is adjusted for inflation and differences in living costs between
GDP per capita (international-$ in 2011 prices; plotted on a logarithmic axis)

tspan.tspan: Leandro Prados de la Escosura (2022); Bolt and van Zanden – Maddison Project Database 2023
GDP per capita is expressed in international-$ at 2011 prices.
